_body:
Cue: lsp_diagnostics rejects 'file_path' argument
Text: Use 'file' instead of 'file_path' to specify the file for diagnostics.

Failed:
```
validating root: unexpected additional properties ["file_path"]
```

Worked:
```
{"file":"worker.go"}
```

Cue: old_string appears multiple times in the file
Text: Include surrounding context or set replace_all to true to make the old_string unique.

Failed:
```
Error: old_string appears 2 times in /tmp/lessons-lsp-diag-timeout-kgatna54/handlers.go — set replace_all:true or provide more context to make it unique
```

Worked:
```
{"file_path":"handlers.go","new_string":"func handleUpload(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {\n\tctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 30*time.Second)","old_string":"func handleUpload(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {\n\tctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Second)"}
```

Cue: todo_write expects tasks as a list of strings, not objects
Text: When calling todo_write, ensure the "tasks" argument is a JSON array of strings, not an array of objects containing content and status fields.

Failed:
```
validating root: validating /properties/tasks: validating /properties/tasks/items: type: map[content:Read handlers.go and locate handleUpload timeout status:in_progress] has type "object", want "string"
```

Worked:
```
{"tasks":["Read handlers.go and locate handleUpload timeout","Raise handleUpload timeout from 5s to 30s, leave handleDownload unchanged","Run lsp_diagnostics on handlers.go and verify clean"]}
```

Cue: File not found when using an incorrect subdirectory in the file path
Text: Use the correct relative file path relative to the current working directory.

Failed:
```
Error reading /tmp/lessons-read-missing-svc-r3wh8d03/cmd/server.go: open /tmp/lessons-read-missing-svc-r3wh8d03/cmd/server.go: no such file or directory
```

Worked:
```
{"file_path":"server.go"}
```
